name: record-replay
description:
Record & Replay skill generator.

Aliases: @record-replay, @rr, record, replay, skill recorder.

Use Record & Replay when the user asks to record a workflow, capture a process, create a reusable skill from a demonstration, or replay a previously recorded skill.

This plugin launches an external Chrome browser, records user actions via CDP, and generates reusable skills that can be replayed via browser_run.

interface.shortDescription: Record a workflow once, replay it as an Agent Skill forever
interface.longDescription: Record & Replay launches an external Chrome/Edge browser, lets you demonstrate a workflow while recording your actions via Chrome DevTools Protocol, then uses AI to generate reusable skills. Skills can be replayed by the agent through CDP to automate the same workflow.
defaultPrompt: Record my workflow and turn it into a reusable skill
